title: Black Friday traffic caused 502 errors
description: During the peak hour about one in five requests returned 502 for twenty minutes.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Root cause: the database ran out of connections because each web instance opened its own pool and the instance count tripled during autoscaling.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Fixed by putting a connection pooler in front of the database so total connections stay fixed however many instances run.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: We rejected a larger database server because it would have cost more every month to fix a problem that only appears at peak.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Gotcha: the pool size per instance must be smaller than the database connection limit divided by the maximum number of instances.
